description_en: Queries a list of the resources of a specific resource in an account group
description_zh: 查询账号组内指定资源的相关资源列表
kebab_example: aliyun config list-aggregate-resource-relations --resource-id i-j6cajg9yrfoh4sas0000 --resource-type ACS::ECS::Instance --biz-region cn-shanghai --aggregator-id ca-856a626622af00330000 --resource-account-id 1009318965420000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAggregateResourceRelations

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region in which the resource resides
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The ID of the account group
parameters.name: aggregator_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the resources in the account group belong
parameters.help_zh: 账号组内待查询资源所属的阿里云账号ID
parameters.name: resource_account_id

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用NextToken再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return for a single request. Valid values: 1 to 1000
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求返回结果的最大条数。取值范围：1~1000
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The type of the resource that is associated with the object

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource that is associated with the object
parameters.name: target_resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the relationship between the resource and the object.

Valid values:

IsContained: The object is included as part of the resource.
IsAttachedTo: The object is added to the resource.
IsAssociatedIn: The object is associated with the resource.
